introHtml: Miir bar wine gift sets combine award-winning vacuum-insulated drinkware with the brand’s commitment to sustainability. These sets, featuring wine tumblers and straw cups, keep beverages at the perfect temperature for hours. Ideal for corporate holiday gifts or client appreciation, each piece can be laser engraved or screen printed with your logo. Miir’s clean design and durable construction make these sets a premium choice that recipients will use daily.
